resources.string: Run a ~35-second window, Surface, View and Compose test, then view or export the report

Keep this screen visible. Ten animation phases compare callback timing, window requests, View/Compose High votes and SurfaceView/TextureView production requests. Switching apps or cancelling stops the test and keeps a partial report. No system settings are changed.

Scope: this is an isolated diagnostic Activity in the launcher process, not the launcher home window or the game Activity. It uses Android View/Compose Canvas, not the game JVM, EGL renderer or Swappy. Production request helpers are reused, but the workload differs. App-reported Hz, selected display-mode Hz and callback frequency are different measurements. Callback/draw counts are not presentation FPS or physical panel scanout. A returned setter or installed High modifier does not prove system acceptance. This app cannot read privileged display-policy dumps or a definitive vendor rejection reason.

Interpretation: compare each phase separately. If the app-reported rate stays below target after a submitted request, system policy or request-path differences remain possible; this report cannot name a specific cause. If app-reported Hz reaches target but callbacks are slower, inspect scheduling/rendering load rather than assuming physical 60 Hz. Game settings here are persisted values, not runtime measurements. For unresolved cases, collect serial-bound, read-only display/window/SurfaceFlinger/game/power/thermal dumps and system logs during active launcher scrolling and gameplay. Slow intervals exceed 1.5× the target callback period; they are not proven dropped frames. Thermal status uses Android values 0–6; battery temperature is in tenths of a degree Celsius. Review firmware identifiers and configuration before sharing. Window preferences and keep-screen-on are restored; no device settings or game preferences are modified.
SurfaceView: production window + Surface + View votes
TextureView: production window + Surface + View votes
